moodys.citation_text: Moody's assigns Aa3 to Trinity Health Credit Group's (MI) Ser. 2022; outlook stable. Moody's Investors Service has assigned an Aa3 rating to Trinity Health Credit Group's Hospital Revenue Bonds Series MI 2022A and Series MI 2022B... Moody's has also affirmed the Aa3, P-1, and Aa3/VMIG 1 ratings on Trinity Health Credit Group's outstanding rated debt. The outlook is stable.
moodys.verification_note: Starting rating carried forward from Dec 2021 Moody's affirmation. No intervening Moody's rating action found between 2021-12-09 and 2022-12-31.

sp.citation_text: Trinity Health Credit Group, MI 2022A-B Bonds Rated 'AA-' (2021/12/10, S&P Global Ratings' Credit Research). S&P AA-/A-1+ ratings (with stable outlook on long-term) on Trinity Health Credit Group debt; affirmed in this report.
sp.verification_note: Starting rating derived from December 2021 S&P new-issue report and subsequently re-confirmed at AA-/A-1+ in the Dec 6, 2023 affirmation cited below. No intervening downgrade found.

fitch.citation_text: Livonia, Mich.-based Trinity Health... has had its ratings affirmed at 'AA-,' both for bonds it holds and for the company's overall rating, Fitch said Dec. 1 [2022]. The outlook for the healthcare group, which holds about $6.9 billion of debt, remains stable.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch reaffirmed Trinity Health's 'AA-' Issuer Default Rating and ratings on ~$6B of revenue bonds; outlook stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch cited expectation that Trinity will continue improving operating EBITDA margins (operating EBITDA margin grew from -1.5% in FY2023 to 5% in FY2024 ending June 30); expects long-term operating EBITDA margins to reach 8%-8.5% as TogetherTeam care model is fully implemented
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch is bullish on Trinity's future: 6 notes (Becker's Hospital Review, Dec. 5, 2024). The ratings agency reaffirmed Trinity's 'AA-' rating as one of the largest rated multi-state systems. Fitch expects Trinity will keep improving its operating EBITDA margins... Operating EBITDA margin grew from -1.5% in the 2023 fiscal year to 5% in the 2024 fiscal year, ending June 30.

outcome_class_rationale: All three agencies affirmed Trinity Health Credit Group (MI) at the same rating they carried entering 2023 with stable outlooks throughout the window: Moody's Aa3 stable (no rating action found in window; surveillance announcement on JOA termination June 2024), S&P AA-/A-1+ stable (affirmed Dec 6, 2023), Fitch AA- stable (affirmed Dec 5, 2024 per Becker's coverage citing Fitch). The prior hand-curation tagged this as 'DOWNGRADE: S&P A+ from AA-' which is NOT supported by primary sources; S&P explicitly affirmed AA- in Dec 2023 and no S&P downgrade is found anywhere in the 2023-01-01 to 2025-03-31 window.
